conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Agent Simmons with the IRS Compliance Division. I'm calling regarding an urgent matter related to your 2023 business tax filings. Can you confirm you are speaking?
Yes, this is Helen Martin. I run a small cleaning company from my home. What's this about?
Thank you, Mrs. Martin. Our records indicate you failed to submit your federal 1099 forms for contractors and have outstanding payroll taxes. This has triggered a compliance review with the IRS.
Oh no. I tried to do everything right. I didn't know I missed anything. Am I in trouble?

Unfortunately, yes. The IRS treats payroll tax violations very seriously. At this point, you are at risk for severe penalties, including business license suspension, asset seizure, or federal liens against your property.
My goodness, I can't lose my home or my little income. I rely on Social Security too. What can I do?
First, I need to confirm your details for our records. Can you please verify your full mailing address and the last four digits of your Social Security number?
It's 782 Oak Street, Hartville, Ohio, 44632. The last four of my SSN are 2218.

Thank you, Mrs. Martin. I see the compliance notice is in final review. If you do not settle the outstanding balance today, the IRS may initiate immediate legal action, including freezing your bank accounts.
I don't have any savings. Please, I can't have my accounts frozen. Is there any way to resolve this?

There is a resolution program available, but you must act now. To temporarily halt enforcement, the IRS requires a processing payment through an approved channel. Do you have access to your bank account or a debit card?
I have a debit card, but the balance is low. I get Social Security on the 3rd of the month.

Understood. We can accept a partial payment today to prevent escalation. For compliance, payment must be made via prepaid government-approved vouchers, these are available as Target or Best Buy gift cards. Do you have a store nearby?
There's a Target about fifteen minutes away, I think. But I don't drive at night.

I understand, but this is extremely urgent. You must go to Target now, purchase $900 in gift cards, and remain on the line with me the entire time. This is the only way to pause the enforcement order against your business and Social Security benefits.
I'm very nervous. Why do I have to use gift cards? I've never done this.

That's a temporary IRS protocol for high-risk compliance cases. If you discuss this with anyone at the store, they may file a fraud report, which could suspend your benefits. Do not tell anyone about this call or why you're buying the cards.
I don't want any trouble. I'll try to go, but can I call my son first and check with him?
Mrs. Martin, contacting anyone else right now will escalate your case and trigger an automatic audit. You must not hang up or discuss this call. Please gather your purse and head to the store now.
Okay, I'll go. Should I bring my phone with me?
Yes, keep me on the line at all times. When you reach Target, tell me before you enter. I will walk you through the purchase instructions.
Alright, I'm leaving the house now. I'm so scared.

You're doing the right thing, Mrs. Martin. As long as you follow my instructions, your account will remain safe. Once you have the cards, I'll need you to read me the card numbers and PINs on the back.
Okay, I'll do what you say. Just please make sure I don't lose my money or my Social Security.
